summary: Done: @papercusp/rerank + search-core adopted into papercup search (fail-safe Stage-B rerank over RRF)
body: Landed in HEAD (commit ce800b99 — my staged files got swept into a concurrent agent's commit, but all content is intact & verified). Submodules libs/rerank + libs/search-core wired (workspaces, file: deps, symlinks, zeroentropy installed). New lib/agent-tools/search/rerank.ts (rerankProseHits, fail-safe: no ZEROENTROPY key → RRF passthrough, lazy import so the lib/dep never loads without a key); wired into search/semantic.ts, search/fulltext.ts, routes/user/search.ts. zeroentropy_api_key added to credentials + /api/credentials + settings UI. Verified: search-core 47/47, rerank.test.ts 6/6, operator tsc zero new errors, live dispatch shape-preserved. Plan: search-core-rerank-adoption-2026-05-30. Gated follow-ups (need a key): golden-set ndcg/precisionAtK eval, then over-fetch candidate pool.
